title: The QuickBooks connection check does not run for roles without Integrations
custom_preconds:
1. A custom role is set up with Settings > Parts ON and Settings > Integrations OFF, with a user to log in as.
  2. QuickBooks is connected for the organization.

custom_steps_separated.content: Log in as that user and open Parts > Categories.
Wait for the page to finish loading.
Watch for any messages during and after loading.
custom_steps_separated.expected: No 'An error occurred while checking QuickBooks connection.' message is shown.

evidence: Steps-Separated case; reworded to layman. Needs live UI.
